title: Press Enter to confirm the table name
goal: uses keyboard events to bind the confirmation operation of the table card name to Enter.
summary: keydown is triggered when the user presses a key. The key attribute of the event saves the key name, which can be used to decide whether to perform the confirmation action.
tasks: listens for keydown on the #table-name input box.
When event.key is Enter, write the current value of the input box to #table-card. Normal input and other keystrokes retain the confirmed table text.

example.note: Reading page monitors Escape and uses it to close additional prompts.

hint: When pressing the letter key to update the table card, check whether the update code is only run when event.key is equal to Enter. The first letter of Enter is capitalized.
